title: Signal fusion strategy
subtitle: Blend Kronos, the four-agent committee, and custom components. Saved changes apply from the next trading cycle.

mixer.label: Trust mixer
mixer.description: Each component emits an independent direction and confidence, then the system combines them deterministically with these trust weights. Enabled weights must equal exactly 100%.
mixer.must_total: Bring enabled component weights back to 100% before saving.
mixer.enable_one: Enable at least one signal component.

components.title: Signal components
components.description: Components provide market opinions only. Position sizing, exits, and risk remain centralized.
components.empty: No signal components are installed. Register one on the server first.

settings.title: Decision and exit settings
settings.description: These shared rules turn the fused signal into a target position and protection plan.
settings.neutral_threshold_hint: Stay flat when the absolute fused score is below this level.
settings.max_target_ratio_hint: Maximum share of the per-pair risk allowance available to the signal layer.
settings.atr_stop_multiplier_hint: Volatility distance between the current price and protective stop.
settings.reward_ratio_hint: Take-profit distance relative to the stop distance.
settings.hitl_hint: Paper and live plans enter the approval queue. Backtests always remain automatic.

save.next_cycle: The current cycle is immutable; the next cycle reads the new profile.
save.success: Saved and active from the next cycle
save.error: Save failed. The active runtime profile is unchanged; check the values and retry.

runtime.mixer_description: Enabled component weights must total 100%; every cycle fuses them once.
runtime.invalid: Enable at least one component and make weights total 100%.
runtime.committee_models_description: The four committee members, debate, and summary models are stored in database configuration.
runtime.draft_notice: Edits remain in this draft until you save them.
runtime.kronos_description: Time-series forecasts and market structure signals
runtime.committee_description: Internal debate across technical, on-chain, news, and macro analysis

load.error_title: Could not load the strategy profile
load.error_description: The server is still using the active profile. Reconnect and retry.
